Name: Sebastian Genderbend MOD- English Translation
Author: ZeliaSong
Description:
[size=5]Welcome to experience the Sebastian Genderbend MOD, which you can also simply refer to as the "Sis Sebby MOD".
[/size]
[size=4][b]❗❗This is the English translation file for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30353]Sebastian Genderbend MOD[/url], which must be used in conjunction with the Sebastian Genderbend MOD. For specific usage instructions, please see the details below.❗❗
[/b][/size]
[size=3]On the basis of retaining the original art style, we have transformed the NPC Sebastian from male to female. Not only does this include new portraits and character images, but also the addition of heart events, with more surprises and details in the game waiting for you to discover.[/size]



[size=4]:: Requirements ::[/size]
[size=3]• Stardew Valley up to date[/size]
[size=3]• SMAPI - Stardew Modding API up to date[/size]
[size=3]• Content Patcher up to date[/size]
[size=3]• [/size][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30353]Sebastian Genderbend MOD[/url][/b][size=3] up to date[/size]



[size=4]:: Features ::[/size]
[size=3]• 😎New Look: The brand new portraits and character images have been designed for Sebastian. We have tried to retain the original art style to ensure the character does not appear out of place in the game.[/size]

[size=3]• 👗 Special Outfits: New special outfits have been added, including the Flower Dance Festival look, wedding attire, Halloween costume, Ginger Island vacation outfit, and band performance attire, allowing players to see another side of her on special occasions and holidays.[/size]

[size=3]•❤️ New Storyline: Exclusive affection storylines have been added for Sebastian (unlocked at 9 hearts in Sebastian's bedroom). The dialogue is close to the original character's personality to provide an immersive experience for players.[/size]

[size=3]• 💬 Dialogue and Lines: In-game references to Sebastian have been changed to female, with some text content optimized, and modifying some dialogue expressions to make communication with the character more vivid and smooth.[/size]



[b][size=4]:: Usage Instructions :: [/size][/b]
[size=3](The installation steps for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url]are omitted;[b] Please ensure that you have installed these two mods before proceeding with the following steps.[/b])
1.Download the [b]Sebastian Genderbend MOD[/b] file and this[b] English translation[/b] file.
2.[b]Extract[/b] the [b]Sebastian Genderbend MOD[/b] file into the [b]"Mods folder"[/b] of the Stardew Valley game directory.
3.[b]Copy and paste[/b] the [b][i]content.json[/i][/b] and [b][i]manifest.json[/i][/b] files from this [b]English translation[/b] file into the [b]Sebastian Genderbend MOD[/b] directory, [b]replacing[/b] the original files.❗(You only need to paste and replace[b] the two JSON files[/b]; there's no need to extract the English translation MOD folder into the Mods folder.)❗
4.The English translation file installation is complete; enjoy your game![/size]



[size=5]🥰[/size]
[size=3]We warmly invite you to follow us for the most up-to-date information on [b]MOD updates and related information[/b].It would be great if you could share your gaming experiences with us. If you encounter any [b]bugs or translation issues[/b] while playing, please contact us through the following channels.[/size]
[size=4][b]YouTube:[url=https://youtube.com/@pigeonwalk?si=5tw3QQuh1wLSh-zF]PigeonWalk_[/url]
X: [url=https://x.com/WalkPigeon_?t=K1MA-KrTbE0xijDUT3mStw&s=09]Pigeon_Walk[/url][/b][/size]



[size=4]::  Acknowledgements ::[/size]
[size=3]♦ Special thanks to SanSheng and QinYu for their mod creation tutorials, especially for the assistance provided by [b]QinYu[/b].
♦ Our gratitude goes to the [b]Stardew Valley Tieba Chinese Localization Team [/b]for their authorization! 
[/size]


[size=3][b]While enjoying the game, it is imperative that you respect the intellectual property rights of the creators.[/b] Except for the game's original content, the unauthorized use of any MOD-related text, images, or other materials is strictly prohibited without the express consent of the copyright holder. Redistribution or republication of such content requires prior authorization from the author and must include proper attribution to the MOD. We urge all users to employ MODs in a manner that is compliant with these terms to preserve the integrity and harmony of the gaming environment.[/size]
